# Monitoring Dashboard Guide

Design effective monitoring dashboards.

## Key Metrics
- Request rate (RPM)
- Error rate (5xx percentage)
- Latency (P50, P95, P99)
- Saturation (CPU, memory, disk)

## Dashboard Layout
- Golden signals at the top
- Service health in the middle
- Detailed breakdowns at bottom
- Time range selector

## Alerting Rules
- Alert on symptoms, not causes
- Set appropriate thresholds
- Avoid alert fatigue
